name: haxtheweb
description: Official Claude Code plugins for the HAX ecosystem — onboarding, site operations, and OpenStax conversion, all built around the HAX CLI (@haxtheweb/create).

plugins.name: hax-onboarding
plugins.description: Golden-path onboarding for HAX: auto-installs the HAX CLI, ships a knowledge skill, and provides slash commands (quickstart, site, webcomponent, audit, serve, publish) to go from nothing to a live HAXsite in one pass.

plugins.name: hax-site-ops
plugins.description: Operate HAX sites from Claude Code using the HAX CLI and HAX web components — add pages, create courses, update content, inspect, validate, and publish. Ships a site-operations skill plus reference docs.

plugins.name: openstax2hax
plugins.description: Prepare OpenStax books for conversion into HAX sites — inspect source files, extract content structure, and generate HAX handoff prompts. Ships a skill plus import/inspect/prepare/handoff slash commands.
